sources.title: Mercer County 2024 Primary Election detailed results (Clarity/SCYTL detail XML, linked from the County Clerk's archived election results page; file dated 2025-01-10)
Mercer County 2026 Primary Election detailed results (Clarity): 250 Democratic county committee contests, no Republican county committee contests
Mercer County 2025 Primary Election detailed results (Clarity): no county committee contests
Mercer County 2022 Primary Election detailed results (Clarity): Democratic county committee only, no Republican county committee contests
Mercer County Clerk archived election results page (returned HTTP 403 to automated requests on 2026-11-27; its write-in reports and district canvass PDFs could not be read)

notes: Mercer Republicans elected county committee in the June 4, 2024 primary; the 2022, 2025 and 2026 primary results contain no Republican county committee contests, so 2024 is the most recent election (apparently a 4-year cycle). Each district's contest is 'Members of County Committee - <town> District <n> (REP)', vote for 2, without separate male/female lines, so seats are labeled 'Member' and statuses are assigned by count, not by gender. The Clarity results list a contest only where a Republican filed (124 of 243 districts) and report no write-in votes. Filled = one of the top two named candidates with at least one vote. With one named candidate, the second seat is unknown; districts with no Republican contest have both seats unknown, because write-in totals and Mercer's write-in winners report were not available (mercercounty.org blocked automated requests), so 'empty' could not be confirmed anywhere. 3 districts had three candidates; in Hamilton Twp 10 the second and third candidates tied, so that seat is unknown. 2024 results predate NJ's district-level suppression, so no counts were suppressed. Precinct names are as printed in the results (federal-ballot pseudo-precincts excluded). Appointments after June 2024 are not captured.
